items.exampleEn: Driver fatigue is a common cause of road accidents.
items.exampleZh: 駕駛疲勞是車禍常見的原因之一。

items.exampleEn: The film shows how a traumatic event can change a whole town.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影呈現了一個造成創傷的事件如何改變整個小鎮。
items.glossZh: 造成創傷的；痛苦難忘的

items.exampleEn: The bird made its home in a cavity in the old tree.
items.exampleZh: 那隻鳥把家安在老樹的樹洞裡。

items.exampleEn: Road safety experts study every fatality to find its cause.
items.exampleZh: 交通安全專家會研究每一起死亡事故，找出原因。

items.exampleEn: Adrenaline makes your heart beat faster when you are afraid.
items.exampleZh: 害怕的時候，腎上腺素會讓你的心跳加快。

items.exampleEn: She got a blister on her hand from digging in the garden all morning.
items.exampleZh: 她在花園挖了一整個早上的土，手上起了水泡。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother worked as a midwife for forty years.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶當了四十年的助產士。

items.sentenceEn: My new shoes gave me a painful blister on my heel.
items.sentenceZh: 新鞋讓我的腳跟磨出了一個很痛的水泡。

items.audioEn: The dentist found a small cavity in one of my back teeth.
items.audioZh: 牙醫在我後排的一顆牙齒上發現了一個小蛀洞。
options: A small hole in a back tooth

items.sentenceEn: Jumping from the high board gave me a rush of adrenaline.
items.sentenceZh: 從高台跳下去，讓我的腎上腺素一下子飆升。

items.sentenceEn: By the end of the long trip, fatigue showed on everyone's faces.
items.sentenceZh: 長途旅行快結束時，每個人臉上都露出疲態。

items.stemEn: Getting lost in a big city as a child was a ____ experience for him.
items.stemZh: 小時候在大城市裡走失，對他來說是一次造成創傷的經歷。

items.stemEn: In the past, most babies in the village were delivered by a local ____.
items.stemZh: 過去，村子裡大多數的嬰兒都是由當地的助產士接生的。

items.passageEn: Every summer, volunteers join the mountain rescue team in our area. Their training is hard: long night walks cause fatigue, and many new members end up with blisters on their feet. Still, they say the adrenaline of a real rescue makes it worth it. The volunteers are conscientious, and they also teach walkers how to stay safe. Since the team was formed, the number of fatalities on the mountain has dropped sharply. One leader explained that getting lost can be a traumatic experience, so team members are trained to stay calm and speak kindly.
items.passageZh: 每年夏天，都有志工加入我們這一帶的山區救難隊。他們的訓練很辛苦：長時間的夜間行走讓人疲勞，很多新成員腳上都磨出水泡。儘管如此，他們說真正救援時那種刺激感，讓一切都值得。這些志工做事認真負責，也會教登山客如何保護自己的安全。自從救難隊成立以來，山上的死亡人數大幅下降。一位隊長解釋，迷路可能是一次很痛苦難忘的經歷，所以救難人員都受過訓練，要保持冷靜、溫和地說話。

questions.questionZh: 新成員在訓練時常會怎樣？
救難隊成立之後有什麼改變？
options: 山上死亡人數大幅下降
登山客必須付費才能上山健行

referenceEn: The dentist said I have a cavity.
The dentist told me that I had a cavity.
rubricZh: cavity 在牙齒上指「蛀牙洞」（例如 have a cavity 等）
「說」可寫，例如 said、told me 等；時態配合 said 用 have 或 had 都可以

items.instructionZh: 用 adrenaline 造一個句子，說說一次讓你感到刺激、腎上腺素上升的經驗。
referenceEn: I felt a rush of adrenaline before my first public speech.
Watching a close football match always gets my adrenaline going.
rubricZh: adrenaline 表示「腎上腺素；刺激感」（例如 a rush of adrenaline、gets my adrenaline going 等）
句子要說到你自己的經驗

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：跟讀「長時間用電腦造成眼睛疲勞」是保健說法（§11.30）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改成中性描述 By the end of the long trip, fatigue showed on everyone's faces.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：cavity 在牙齒上指「蛀牙洞」（例如 have a cavity 等）／「說」可寫，例如 said、told me 等；時態配合 said 用 have 或 had 都可以
